_comment: Chapter lists read off each book's own printed contents page and then
checked against the pages they point at. These books are scans with no
text layer, so no parser can reach this; the pages below were confirmed
by rendering each one and seeing the chapter open there.
'offset' records printedPage - pdfPage, measured from folios sampled
across the book. It is kept for provenance: it is what makes the page
'page' is the 1-based PDF page, already offset-corrected.
